explorationReceipt.approximateInspectedScope: Approximately 102 named tracks across Juno's current techno bestsellers and product pages, Boomkat's current new-release feed and exact product pages, plus linked official/current catalogue windows. Written attributed descriptions and exact listings only; no audio audition.
exclusions: Jay Mitta — Sawa and Lotic — Carried remain removed after severe listener feedback; Luigi Tozzi — Tender Is The Night remains positively retained. Explicit threat- or panic-coded propositions were deprioritized without creating a blanket intensity or genre ban.

Completed discovery Runs 245–250 and persistent target/global discovery state were compared before ranking. Previously evaluated, parked, rejected, unresolved, duplicate and exact-alternate identities were excluded.

Rene Wise — Night Time Swim, Mark Fell — Servitude In Context titles, Mike Dehnert — One O Eight, Confusion — In Cycles titles, Aquarian — Kool Ranch FM and the previously unresolved Los Totes remixes were screened but excluded as persistent-state repeats.

The top three leads come from distinct current, adjacent and overlooked-catalogue releases and test distinct non-frozen boundaries. No proposed placement splits or reorders either protected internal handoff in Transparency → When We Froze → Stardancer.

Run 250's no-ADD outcome and Run 249's ADD do not control this run. Candidate order reflects differentiated exact-track evidence, canonical potential and information gain rather than novelty, artist diversity or resolver convenience.
rankedLeadSummary: 1. Oscar Escapa, Horacio Cruz — Bazaar Star
2. Violeta García, Hora Lunga — emotional baggage allowance
4. Oscar Escapa, Horacio Cruz — Proud Generation
6. Violeta García, Hora Lunga — la ola or i miss u
7. Oscar Escapa, Horacio Cruz — Awakening Education
8. Oscar Escapa, Horacio Cruz — In The Wall
sourceWindows: CURRENT RELEASE WINDOW: Juno's current techno bestseller and exact product pages, especially Oscar Escapa and Horacio Cruz's Proud Generation EP on Special Series, released 2026-09-03 and checked 2026-09-14. https://www.juno.co.uk/products/oscar-escapa-horacio-cruz-proud-generation-ep-vinyl/1174238-01/

ADJACENT / EMERGING WINDOW: Violeta García and Hora Lunga's 4ever on -OUS, released digitally in September 2026, whose current notes foreground interrupted and restarted fragments, unpredictable redirection and unstable song surfaces without implying techno orthodoxy. https://boomkat.com/products/4ever-4673ce4b-bbd9-4f14-a453-1f5ca4cb1b16

OVERLOOKED CATALOGUE / REISSUE WINDOW: Charles Dodge's 1976 Synthesized Voices, reissued by Death Is Not The End in 2026, and Baby Ford's Bford 14, reissued 2026-07-13. Exact-track criticism was used without treating historical prestige as fit. https://boomkat.com/products/synthesized-voices · https://www.juno.co.uk/products/baby-ford-bford-14-vinyl/1143060-01/
